items.title: Containerize SQL Server on AWS to reduce licensing costs and simplify operations
items.summary: This blog post shows you how to containerize Microsoft SQL Server databases using Linux containers on Amazon Web Services (AWS), reducing Windows and database licensing costs while maintaining the same performance and compatibility you rely on today.
